name: Too Late to Panic! Home V5.13-r6
body:
The duplicate lower-right action button is removed; the small rounded object key bubble remains. Normal startup still opens automatically in fullscreen. The large interaction prompt is replaced by a small rounded object key bubble showing the actual action. This version supersedes local r3 and r5 packages/prepared indexes that were never pushed, tagged or released.

Critical hazard preparations use actual anchor, main-power, gas-valve and roof states. Missing hazard preparations add real bounded damage while existing food/water/physical-shelter gates stay authoritative. A damaged structure group can lose one upgrade tier after a real normal disaster, with one deterministic group draw per run/wave. Upper walls and the installed roof wear together; T0 remains the floor and current resolved damage is unchanged. Tutorial/simulation/short flow and F3/no-loss do not produce tier wear. Nearby prompts use the actual action key and the next-wave announcement displays the already selected real hazards.

The retained upper panic room has a reinforced door, protected fittings, first-aid station, retained emergency radio and clear room identity. Tables, chairs, sofas and beds now support the real two-screw anchoring action with the original paid cost and free cancellation. Existing base item risks are retained alongside the new explicit critical-task damage. Material warnings are tied to a real failed work attempt and clear with their target/shortage.

Intro, earthquake and result cameras have different composed angles, short within-shot moves and editorial cuts. Outdoor civilians are hidden during hazards. Retained response vehicles/helicopter are hidden and silent in the next preparing/disaster phase and arrive after an actual outcome; active Storm weather/audio ends before rescue. Upperfloor walls and roof upgrade together; the roof is not selected separately.

Windows64 portable ZIP. Extract fully and run TooLateToPanic.exe. Existing 90s precautions +40s supplies,1500starting budget, finite stock, physics, damage and score rules retained.

810 Editor checks and 405 same-DLL native API/render checks passed; 12 framebuffers inspected. Additionally 291 same-DLL retained presentation checks and 12 captures, plus 10 normal fullscreen startup observations and 1 captures were verified. Shared regressions are not claimed as unique tests. Actual critical-task, grouped-wear, key-prompt and wave-announcement report rows are the verification scope. Actor/camera and funded/mixed/stale model fixtures were declared. V5.12 was a verified intermediate source/player candidate, not a separately packaged, indexed or published release; its previous counts are not transferred to this DLL. OS input and human play/readability/listening acceptance remain NOT_RUN; this is a prerelease awaiting user playtest. This version's procedural room visual details, camera direction, code/Turkish labels/tests used OpenAI Codex. Retained emergency-radio/room assets keep their provenance and licenses; no new external model/shader/sound/provider credits/payment. No competition submission was performed.
